title: viola odorata subsp. beraudii
intro: Viola odorata subsp. beraudii, commonly known as Beraud's violet, is a subspecies of the sweet-scented violet plant, belonging to the family Violaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of digestive issues, skin conditions, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Beraud's violet include its ability to calm and soothe the mind and body, making it a popular ingredient in herbal teas and remedies for anxiety and stress relief. The bioactive constituents of Viola odorata subsp. beraudii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable plant in traditional herbalism.
